name: Punctured-Cube Pendant Contraction Obstructions
definition: Let $|X|=d\ge4$, let $W\subseteq X$ be a singleton, choose $A\subseteq X$ with $2\le|A\triangle W|\le d-2$, and introduce $e\notin X$. Set $\mathcal K_d^-(W)=2^X\setminus\{W\}$ and $\mathcal R_{d+1}(W,A)=\{A\}\cup\{K\cup\{e\}:K\in\mathcal K_d^-(W)\}$.
parameters: $d\ge4$ and Hamming distance $2\le t=|A\triangle W|\le d-2$; the family has $d+1$ active coordinates and $2^d$ states.
canonical_form: Up to cube isometries fixing the missing singleton $W$, the pointed base type is determined by $t=|A\triangle W|$.
recognition: A construction certificate supplies the missing singleton, the complementary critical root pair, and the pendant coordinate. Every one-coordinate contraction is then checked by the root-repair criterion.
comments: Every member is contraction-minimal outside learning-space graphs. This does not assert pc-minimality because learning-space graphs are not closed under convex restrictions.
